summary: Magic Maze is a real-time cooperative game where players silently control all characters (not just their own) using shared movement icons, racing against a sand timer to complete a heist without speaking. The communication restriction creates a unique, often hilarious, chaotic tension as players must anticipate each other's moves.
praised: scales well solo to eight players
criticised: frustration when players struggle to communicate silently
can feel stressful rather than fun for some groups
modular map setup takes a bit of time relative to playtime

scoring.why: the team either escapes the maze in time or fails, with no points involved

similar: Escape: The Curse of the Temple
